distribution_model.detail: Sells vacation ownership directly to customers at its resorts; uses Marriott, Hyatt brands under license; exchange and rental services.

market_position.detail: Upper-upscale vacation ownership resorts, with luxury Ritz-Carlton and St. Regis clubs as smaller tiers.

notes: Luxury brands are a small part of the portfolio, so premium chosen as the single position.

product_category.detail: Vacation ownership interests, resort stays, timeshare exchange and rental services, travel options.

purchase_frequency.detail: Vacation ownership is a large, infrequent purchase, with owners vacationing yearly.

sub_sector.value: timeshare vacation ownership; timeshare exchange and rental services
